meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (unitary national jurisdiction; provincial-level Departments of Planning and Investment act as delegated registration authorities)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified statutory system; Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam 2013 at the apex, supplemented by laws, government decrees, ministerial circulars, and Supreme People's Court resolutions and guideline judgments)

Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) - in force for Viet Nam since 14 January 2019
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) - in force for Viet Nam since 1 January 2022
Viet Nam - Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty (1993)
Viet Nam - Netherlands Bilateral Investment Treaty (1994)

Viet Nam - Republic of Korea Bilateral Investment Treaty (2001, as amended)

Double Taxation Agreements with over 80 jurisdictions, including China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Germany, France, United Kingdom, and Australia, relevant for IP royalty and cross-border service structuring

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 of 14 November 2022 (effective 1 March 2023); Government Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP of 28 April 2023 detailing AML/CFT obligations and beneficial-owner definitions; State Bank of Vietnam Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of 18 December 2023 implementing the AML Law, including beneficial-owner identification, PEP screening, and suspicious-transaction reporting; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Government Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Law on Prevention and Control of Corruption No. 36/2005/QH11 (as amended); Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13; Law No. 93/2015/QH13 on Administrative Procedures as procedural backdrop.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each proposed legal representative, director, and natural-person beneficial owner (25% and above)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or duly registered notary public of the individual's jurisdiction of citizenship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; otherwise Vietnamese consular legalization at the Embassy/Consulate of Viet Nam abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of every corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or business registration authority of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular legalization, followed by official Vietnamese translation and local notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Vietnamese incorporation agent and local counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the jurisdiction where the Power of Attorney is executed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular legalization according to the origin country, with certified Vietnamese translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds statement for the proposed charter capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Depository bank of the investor, authenticated by bank officer authorization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular legalization where required by the receiving bank or DPI; notarized Vietnamese translation mandatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Industrial property attorney registration certificate of the Vietnamese professional-in-charge (industrial property representation service license prerequisite)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Office of Intellectual Property (NOIP), Ministry of Science and Technology of Viet Nam
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic document issued in Viet Nam - notarized copy only; no apostille or consular legalization required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under Law No. 14/2022/QH15 and Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP requiring: (i) identification and verification of all beneficial owners at the 25% threshold, legal representatives, and the professional-in-charge before engagement; (ii) continuous screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions List, and the State Bank of Viet Nam's administrative enforcement list; (iii) enhanced due diligence for all politically exposed persons (PEPs), both domestic and foreign, including family members and close associates, with source-of-wealth verification and senior-management approval; (iv) for a patent-prosecution and trademark-agency profile, verification that no UBO or attorney has been subject to adverse IP-office, bar, or disciplinary rulings indicating money-laundering or trade-based laundering typologies; (v) documented screening evidence in the client acceptance file with mandatory re-screening at least every 12 months.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) - https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; processed by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) Business Registration Office
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Article 38 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the official enterprise name of a Vietnamese LLC must be written in Vietnamese, using the Vietnamese script including diacritical marks, and may include numerals and symbols. The name must begin with 'Công ty TNHH' or 'Công ty Trách nhiệm hữu hạn' followed by the distinctive name. A foreign-language translated name (e.g., English) may be used only as an additional suffix or transliteration in parentheses and may not stand alone; Latin-character brand names must first be transcribed into Vietnamese phonetic script. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any other registered enterprise and must conform to Articles 40-45 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Identical or confusingly similar names of previously registered enterprises in Viet Nam
References to the national flag, national emblem, or national anthem, and use of 'Viet Nam' without competent-authority permission
Names of State agencies, political organizations, military units, or international organizations, such as 'Bộ', 'Tổng cục', 'Công an', 'Quân đội', or 'Liên Hợp Quốc'

Sector tokens requiring conditional business licenses when the corresponding license is not held: 'Ngân hàng' (Bank), 'Chứng khoán' (Securities), 'Bảo hiểm' (Insurance), 'Quỹ đầu tư' (Investment Fund)
IP-sector tokens such as 'Sở hữu trí tuệ' (Intellectual Property) and 'Đại diện sở hữu công nghiệp' (Industrial Property Representation) pending NOIP registration of the representation service
Words contrary to Vietnamese historical, cultural, and ethical traditions as prescribed by Article 39 of the Law on Enterprises
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam does not operate a standalone advance name-reservation mechanism; availability is checked electronically at filing time. If the DPI rejects the proposed name or finds the dossier defective, Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP prescribes: (1) the DPI must issue a written notice stating the exact legal ground within 3 working days of receiving the dossier; (2) the applicant may correct and resubmit a fresh dossier within 6 months of the written refusal without losing filing priority; (3) the applicant may file a complaint with the Director of the DPI under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 within 30 days from the date of receiving the rejection decision, and may appeal to the provincial People's Committee chairman or bring administrative litigation before the competent People's Court under Law No. 93/2015/QH13; (4) no statutory extension of name reservation exists, so the incorporating team preserves the name only through prompt completion of the filing and final registry posting within approximately 30 days of the initial clearance check.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Low acceptance for a regulated professional-services LLC. Article 40 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 requires the registered head office to be a real, identifiable address in Viet Nam used for corporate management. Pure virtual office with no physical occupational presence may be tolerated by some DPIs for general trading LLCs, but it is high-risk for an industrial property representation license because NOIP and the provincial DPI expect a stable, physically verifiable office with signboard, mailbox, and working desks where the registered professional-in-charge conducts the patent-prosecution practice. Only a full-service address-and-administration lease with dedicated space and signboard is advisable for this business scope.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate, estimated at approximately 10-15% annual probability for a compliant patent and trademark agency. The DPI conducts verification of the head-office address at registration and upon complaints with near 100% document-review certainty; unannounced physical inspections are triggered mainly by change-of-office filings, tax authority field audits, NOIP license-compliance examinations, and regulatory complaints or sanctioned-client notifications. For an AML-compliant professional firm with a Vietnamese professional-in-charge and a proper address lease, the expected unannounced inspection frequency is under 10% per year.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Circular No. 47/2019/TT-BTC; online enterprise registration fee approximately VND 50,000-100,000, equivalent to USD 2-4

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DPI / Business Registration Information Portal administration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Circular No. 47/2019/TT-BTC; publication fee approximately VND 100,000, equivalent to USD 4-5

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (relevant LLC and incorporation provisions: Arts. 25-29, 40-47, 50-59, 122-128; corporate seal under Art. 44); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Arts. 30-38 governing investment registration certificates and investment procedures); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration, as amended by Decree No. 28/2022/ND-CP; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHĐT prescribing the enterprise registration application forms and dossier components.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) under the Department of Planning and Investment (Sở Kế hoạch và Đầu tư) of the province or centrally-governed municipality where the company establishes its registered office; if the project is located within an industrial park, export processing zone, or economic zone, jurisdiction is exercised by the Management Board of the relevant zone.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) — Form I-1 under Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHĐT, filed together with the Company Charter (Form I-2 member list and supporting evidence) through the National Business Registration Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies to an intellectual-property agency activity classified under ISIC 7490 under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, or the Law on Fees and Charges. Members freely fix the charter capital in the Company Charter; the foreign-invested company must contribute the full subscribed capital, in cash or lawful assets, within ninety (90) days after issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate; foreign members must remit cash contributions into a licensed direct-investment capital account in a bank authorized to conduct foreign-exchange activity. No escrow account or blocked-account statutory rule is imposed for service-sector LLCs; a failure to contribute in due time triggers interest, compulsory capital adjustment or capital deregistration under Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST ORGANIZATIONAL RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS' COUNCIL OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

Adopted by the members of [Company Name] on __________, 2025, in [City], Viet Nam, pursuant to Articles 54, 55 and 58 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the draft Company Charter approved by the members.

A. Charter Capital Subscription: RESOLVED, that the members severally subscribe to the charter capital of VND ______ (Vietnamese Dong ______), allocated among the members in the proportions set out in the List of Members; each member shall pay the full amount of its subscribed contribution to the company's direct-investment capital account at a licensed bank within ninety (90) days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate; no contribution premium, public offering, or escrow account is required under the Law on Enterprises.

B. Registered Office: RESOLVED, that the company establish and maintain its statutory registered office and principal place of business at __________, [district], [city/municipality], Viet Nam; the General Director is authorized to execute the office lease agreement, to procure the premises documents required by the Business Registration Office, and to register the registered-office particulars in the enterprise registration dossier.

C. Formal Adoption of the Company Charter: RESOLVED, that the draft Company Charter tabled at this meeting is formally adopted as the constitutional instrument governing the company; the governance model shall comprise the Members' Council as the highest decision-making organ and a single General Director acting as the legal representative with ex officio signatory powers; the Charter, as adopted, shall be lodged with the Business Registration Office and shall be binding upon the company, its members and its legal representative.

D. Appointment of Officers: RESOLVED, that [Name of Appointee] be and is hereby appointed as the first General Director (legal representative) of the company for a term of ______ years, with full authority to (i) execute applications and instruments before investment, business-registration, tax, labor, bank and intellectual-property authorities; (ii) negotiate, sign and perform contracts; (iii) open, operate, and close bank accounts; (iv) hire and dismiss employees; (v) sign power-of-attorney and representation mandates; and (vi) represent the company before administrative authorities and courts.

E. Industrial Property Representation Registration: RESOLVED, that the General Director be instructed to complete, without undue delay, the registration of the company as an industrial property representation organization with the National Office of Intellectual Property under Decree No. 99/2013/ND-CP, employing at least one industrial property attorney holding a valid Certificate of Industrial Property Agent Practice who shall be named as the practicing representative.

F. Corporate Seal: RESOLVED, that the company fabricate a round corporate seal bearing the company's accurate enterprise name and enterprise code, and that the seal specimen be notified electronically to the Business Registration Office within five (5) working days of fabrication.

G. General Authorization and Effectiveness: RESOLVED, that all facts, acts, and documents adopted herein are ratified and confirmed; any incidental signature of an authorized member shall be procured forthwith; this Resolution shall become effective upon the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

Adopted and passed this ______ day of __________, 2025, at [City], Viet Nam, by the unanimous affirmative vote of the members representing one hundred percent (100%) of the charter capital.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the foreign-invested industrial-property agency project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment — Investment Registration Division (Phòng Đăng ký đầu tư), or the Management Board of the Industrial Park / Export Processing Zone / Economic Zone if the project is located in such zone; submissions are made on the National Investment Information System at https://dautu.gov.vn or directly at the DPI one-stop-shop.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the enterprise will be a foreign-invested LLC, the foreign investor first files an application for investment project registration under Articles 37-38 of the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP. The application must be attested and submitted in the prescribed Form A-1, accompanied by a project proposal, investor's legal-status documents, audited financial statements or a bank certificate evidencing available funds of the investor for the most recent twelve-month period, the proposed operating location for the registered office and the industrial-property service premises, and, where the applicant is not the investor, a duly executed power of attorney. The DPI reviews the legal and constitutional compatibility of the project and, because patent-prosecution and trademark-registration services are not on the conditional-investment list, issues the IRC directly without referral to the Prime Minister or Provincial People's Committee. The IRC records the project objectives, charter capital, implementation location, duration and the investor's details.
required_dossiers: Written Application for Investment Project Registration (Form A-1)
Project description and implementation plan / feasibility summary
Certified copy of passport or certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor
Financial-capacity evidence, e.g., bank statement or audited financial statements of the last fiscal year
Proposed location of the registered office and service premises with landlord consent or lease pre-commitment
Power of attorney for the authorized applicant (if the investor does not file directly)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is incomplete or the project falls outside the permitted regime, the DPI shall issue a written request for amendment/clarification within five (5) working days. A refusal of the IRC must contain the exact legal grounds; the applicant may within thirty (30) days submit a rectified dossier, request reconsideration by the DPI Director, or lodge an administrative complaint under Law No. 02/2011/QH13 on Complaints, followed by judicial review under Law No. 93/2015/QH13 on Administrative Procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the LLC and obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) of the Department of Planning and Investment via the National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following issuance of the IRC, the legal representative registers the multi-member LLC electronically on the National Business Registration Portal. The portal dossier comprises the Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1), the List of Members (Form I-2), the Company Charter, a certified copy of the IRC, certified and notarized copies of the passports or ID documents of members and legal representatives (with Vietnamese translation and legalization where the document originates abroad), and documentation evidencing the lawful registered-office address, consisting of a lease agreement or written consent of the premises owner. The notarized lease agreement for at least two (2) years of office occupancy is a standard requirement. The system charges the state fee of approximately VND 200,000 (about USD 9). The Business Registration Office reviews the dossier for formal and material completeness under Articles 26-27 and 35 of the Law on Enterprises and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP and issues the ERC within three (3) working days. The ERC simultaneously serves as the enterprise registration certificate and the tax-identification-number certificate; all subsequent public databases are synchronized automatically.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1)
Company Charter signed by all members
List of Members (Form I-2) with capital percentages and contribution schedules
Certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate
Certified passport / ID copies of all members and of the legal representative, with notarized Vietnamese translation if issued abroad
Registered-office lease agreement or premises-owner written consent conferring lawful use
Proof of payment of the enterprise-registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Registration Office refuses or issues a written amendment request, the applicant receives a reasoned notice referencing the deficient items; the applicant may cure and re-submit the dossier within thirty (30) days. A refusal containing legal grounds may be contested by administrative complaint to the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment within ninety (90) days, and subsequently by administrative lawsuit before the competent People's Court under Law No. 93/2015/QH13.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fabricate the corporate seal, notify the seal specimen, and complete the statutory enterprise publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office via the National Business Registration Portal; seal fabrication is carried out by licensed seal-engraving establishments without state pre-approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued, the company may fabricate its corporate seal at its own initiative under Article 44 of the Law on Enterprises. The seal must include the company name and enterprise code. Within five (5) working days from the date of fabrication, the legal representative files the Notice of Seal Specimen (Form I-9 of Circular 01/2021/TT-BKHĐT) online through the National Business Registration Portal. The registry records the seal specimen and simultaneously causes the enterprise's constitutional information (ERC, IRC, charter summary, seal specimen and location) to be publicly announced on the National Business Registration Portal for thirty (30) days; the statutory publication charge is about VND 100,000 (approximately USD 4.3). Until the specimen is recorded, transactions by the company using the seal remain valid, but third parties may verify the seal against the public registry.
required_dossiers: Notice of Seal Specimen (Form I-9)
Enterprise Registration Certificate
Clear scanned image of the seal imprint
Identity document of the legal representative (electronic authentication may suffice)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the portal rejects the seal-specimen submission, the company rectifies the image or data format and re-submits; such administrative rejection has no material effect on corporate validity. For failure of the publication to appear within the statutory window, the company may file a written request for re-publication to the Business Registration Office, and an administrative complaint under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP against any omission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open the direct-investment capital account (DICA) and effect the charter capital contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks in Viet Nam licensed to conduct foreign-exchange activity and to provide direct-investment capital accounts (e.g., Vietcombank, BIDV, Techcombank, or a licensed foreign-bank branch).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal representative presents the IRC, ERC, Company Charter, seal specimen notice, passport and registered-office lease agreement at the chosen licensed bank. The bank opens a direct-investment capital account (tài khoản vốn đầu tư trực tiếp) in Vietnamese đồng or a freely convertible foreign currency, in accordance with Circular No. 09/2021/TT-NHNN on foreign-investment foreign-exchange management. Each member then transfers its subscribed capital from abroad into the DICA, stating the remittance purpose as charter capital contribution under the company's enterprise code. Contributions must be completed within ninety (90) days from ERC issuance; the bank issues credit advices and capital-contribution certificates for each installment. The members' register, showing the paid-in amounts, is updated and made available for audit. Cash payments are not permitted for foreign-invested-enterprise capital contributions. After capital is paid in, the company may lawfully remit profits and recover principal under Circular 09/2021/TT-NHNN.
required_dossiers: Investment Registration Certificate
Enterprise Registration Certificate
Company Charter and List of Members
Corporate seal and seal-specimen notification
Passport of the legal representative (and any authorized signatories)
Registered-office lease agreement or premises evidence
Foreign members' remittance instruction designating the DICA and charter-capital purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the DICA because the KYC documentation is incomplete, the company may cure the deficiency and re-apply, or choose another licensed bank with identical documentation. If a member fails to contribute by the end of the 90-day term, the company must send a written notice demanding performance; if no contribution follows, the Members' Council may adjust the charter capital or apply the statutory consequences of Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises, including mandatory capital adjustment, interest on the late amount, and amendment of the ERC with the Business Registration Office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the NOIP registration as an industrial-property representation organization and complete labor and social-insurance formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Office of Intellectual Property (NOIP) of the Ministry of Science and Technology; provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs; provincial Social Insurance Agency.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: An industrial-property prosecution agency may lawfully render PCT patent, patent-prosecution, industrial-design, and trademark-registration services in Viet Nam only after being registered with the NOIP under Decree No. 99/2013/ND-CP, as amended by Decree No. 75/2019/ND-CP. The company submits to NOIP (Hanoi headquarters or a NOIP representative office) the registration dossier containing: a written application for registration of industrial-property representation activities; a certified copy of the ERC; a list of industrial-property attorneys employed or collaborating with the organization, including copies of their valid Certificates of Industrial Property Agent Practice; specimen service-contract and power-of-attorney forms; and proof that the organization has at least one attorney whose practice certificate is in good standing and registered under the same organization. The NOIP appraises compliance and issues a Certificate of Registration of Industrial Property Representation Services within about fifteen (15) days of a complete dossier. In parallel, the company files the first labor-use declaration with the provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs within thirty (30) days of operation, registers employees for compulsory social, health and unemployment insurance using Forms TK1-TK3 with the Social Insurance Agency, and applies for work permits for any expatriate patent attorneys under Decree No. 152/2020/ND-CP.
required_dossiers: Application for registration of industrial-property representation services (NOIP Form)
Certified copy of the Enterprise Registration Certificate
List of industrial-property attorneys practicing at the organization, with certified copies of their practice certificates
Specimen service contracts and power-of-attorney forms employed by the agency
Labor-use declaration (first declaration within 30 days of activity)
Insurance registration dossiers TK1-TK3 for each employee
Work-permit application dossiers for expatriate legal representatives or foreign attorneys
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOIP identifies deficiencies, it issues a written request for amendment; the applicant may cure within one month from the notice. An adverse refusal of the industrial-property representation registration must state the legal basis, and the company may file a reconsideration request or an administrative complaint to the Ministry of Science and Technology, and ultimately proceed by administrative lawsuit. With respect to labor or social-insurance filings, curing consists of re-submitting corrected electronic declarations; late filings are subject to administrative penalties but may be settled through the rectification and voluntary payment mechanism before a sanction decision becomes final.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: National Office of Intellectual Property (NOIP — Cục Sở hữu trí tuệ) of the Ministry of Science and Technology, which administers the registration of industrial-property representation organizations and the professional supervision of patent and trademark attorneys.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificate of Registration of Industrial Property Representation Services (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký hoạt động dịch vụ đại diện sở hữu công nghiệp).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Agency — Department of Environmental Impact Appraisal and Assessment under the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment of Viet Nam; for provincial-level obligations, the Department of Natural Resources and Environment of the province or municipality where the office is located.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Exempt — a pure professional office housing a patent-prosecution and trademark-registration agency falls below the thresholds of Appendix II to Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP and Schedule II of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14; therefore no full Environmental Impact Assessment report or Environmental Registration Certificate is required, provided the company merely leases a completed office premise. If the company constructs or substantially renovates a new office building, that project may fall into Category III and require an environmental permit if the floor area is at least 5,000 m2 or the project otherwise falls within Article 39 of the Law on Environmental Protection and Clause 2, Article 39 of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For domestic wastewater generated at the office: the effluent must comply with the National Technical Regulation QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT on domestic wastewater (column B: BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, pH 5-9), or, where the office is connected to a centralized municipal sewerage system, with the sewerage services contract and the applicable municipal discharge permit limits. On-site air emissions are minimal; should a backup diesel generator be installed, exhaust gas must comply with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT (industrial stack emissions) and ambient air quality must meet QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT. Hazardous and domestic solid waste generated in office use (toner cartridges, inks, electronic equipment and packaging) must be segregated and transferred to a licensed collection/processing facility under Article 82 of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP, with waste-transfer logs maintained for inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: the company must occupy leased premises within a building that holds the required Fire Prevention and Fighting (PCCC) design approval (văn bản thẩm duyệt thiết kế PCCC) and fire-safety acceptance certificate (văn bản nghiệm thu về PCCC) issued by the competent Fire Police under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP; the tenant must appoint a fire-safety person-in-charge, post escape and signage plans, equip the premises with portable extinguishers, organize annual fire-drill and evacuation training for at least a representative proportion of staff, and maintain the required fire-safety records for the commune-level police inspection. Structural load: the tenant retains from the landlord the building-operation/construction certificate under the Construction Law No. 50/2014/QH13; interior fit-out works that do not affect the structural frame do not require a construction permit, but any structural renovation of the leased floor must be approved by the district-level construction authority. Occupational safety and health: the company is subject to the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13; it must conduct an occupational-hazard inventory, provide office ergonomics, implement annual workplace environmental monitoring to the extent required for office exposure limits (noise per QCVN 22:2016/BYT; lighting per QCVN 23:2016/BYT), and register any lifting or pressure equipment with the provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs where installed; no hazardous production equipment is deployed in a patent-prosecution agency, and no fixed-facility license beyond the general duties is imposed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Official National E-Tax Portal: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; National E-Invoice Data System (Cổng hóa đơn điện tử): https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn. Local administration rests with the provincial Departments of Taxation (Cục Thuế) and district-level Sub-Departments of Taxation (Chi cục Thuế) of the province or centrally managed city in which the LLC holds its tax registration, which in practice coincides with the location of its head office and business registration with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1: File for an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC, Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký đầu tư) with the provincial DPI or the management board of an export processing zone, industrial zone, hi-tech zone, or economic zone, because a 100% foreign-owned patent prosecution agency in ISIC 7490 requires an IP project registration and a capital contribution/membership plan. STEP 2: After the IRC (or concurrently in the one-stop licensing path), file the enterprise registration dossier (charter, list of members, legal representative appointment) with the Business Registration Office of the DPI; the resulting Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC, Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp) states a single 10- or 13-digit enterprise registration code that is simultaneously the enterprise's statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN/MST) and the VAT registration ID; no separate TIN application is made to the tax authority. STEP 3: Within 10 working days after ERC issuance, the LLC must complete its tax registration file on the National E-Tax Portal using a qualified legal digital signature (Chữ ký số), file the initial tax registration information, declare the tax calculation method exclusively for VAT purposes (credit method versus direct method election), register its bank account, and list the authorised legal representatives; failure to activate exposes the LLC to administrative penalties. STEP 4: Obtain the mandatory patent agency practice licence from the National Office of Intellectual Property of Vietnam / Ministry of Science and Technology, as the business requires statutory licensing; the licence is independent of, but complementary to, tax registration. STEP 5: Complete e-invoice template registration under Decree 123/2020 and Circular 78/2021, open an offshore/inward remittance capable foreign-currency bank account for export service proceeds, and begin monthly or quarterly provisional CIT declarations and monthly VAT/e-invoice reporting. STEP 6: Any branch or place of business located in another province must obtain its own dependent TIN, while the head office retains the parent TIN and centralises VAT refund and CIT finalisation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: A foreign-invested Limited Liability Company is a Vietnamese resident enterprise taxed on its worldwide income at the headline CIT rate of 20% under the Law on Corporate Income Tax No. 14/2008/QH12 (as amended); profits are taxed at entity level and distributions to foreign corporate shareholders are not subject to an additional corporate dividend withholding tax. No pass-through, partnership flow-through, or fiscal transparency is available. Territorial_Scope caveat: the LLC's liability covers Vietnamese-source income and also foreign-source income attributable to its offshore contracts; conversely, non-resident service providers dealing with the LLC are exposed to the separate Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) regime. Tax_Exempt_Zone: By default the LLC is not located in a tax-exempt zone and must pay standard CIT and standard VAT; however, if the patent prosecution activity is embedded in an export processing enterprise (EPE) or a qualifying economic/hi-tech zone with a separate incentive certificate, alternative CIT/VAT treatment may apply.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam has no US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election under the Tax Administration Law or Decree 132/2020 on transfer pricing. The available statutory elections are: (i) VAT method election: the credit (input-output offset) method is mandatory if the LLC maintains full accounting books and demonstrates annual revenue over VND 1 billion, but micro/small enterprises may elect the direct method on turnover; once elected, the method must be used for at least the full tax year; (ii) FCT method election: when the LLC subcontracts offshore patent associates, it may elect the deduction method under Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC for its foreign contractor payments, provided the foreign contractor maintains accounting records, otherwise the direct withholding method (VAT + CIT deemed rates) applies; (iii) CIT investment incentive election: the investor may apply for the standard 20% rate or petition to apply the incentivised 10%/15% rates, tax holidays, and reductions, in each case only if the investment project and location qualify under the Law on Investment and Decree 218/2013; (iv) No consolidated fiscal unity, group registration, or loss-transfer election exists: the LLC files standalone tax returns.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; Thuế giá trị gia tăng) governed by the Law on Value Added Tax No. 13/2008/QH12, as amended by Law No. 31/2013/QH13, Decree No. 209/2013/ND-CP, and Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC, as supplemented by Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP (e-invoicing). Export of services to foreign parties is within the 0% VAT bracket, while domestic patent and trademark representation services are taxed at the standard rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no economic turnover threshold for compulsory VAT registration of a legal entity: every LLC, including a patent prosecution agency in ISIC 7490, must register for VAT from the date of enterprise registration regardless of revenue. The only revenue-based threshold in the Vietnamese VAT system is VND 100,000,000 per annum of revenue, which concerns households, individual businesses, and cooperatives subject to the direct method; foreign contractors maintaining no permanent establishment in Vietnam must register for FCT/VAT within 10 working days of commencing taxable activities irrespective of turnover. For VAT refund purposes, the effective working credit must exceed the statutory threshold of VND 300,000,000 after a consecutive 12-month period to qualify for an export input VAT refund.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC: every seller must issue a digitally signed e-invoice through a certified e-invoice supplier (or through the tax authority's free web portal) and transmit it immediately upon issuance to the National E-Invoice Data System operated by the General Department of Taxation; transmission is near real-time, and each invoice is attributed a unique transaction code and an embedded encrypted QR code. There is no discretionary digital stamping; for taxpayers without proprietary systems, the tax authority generates a verification code (mã số của cơ quan thuế) before the invoice is legally issued. Large issuers must integrate via secured API/machine-to-machine interfaces. For export invoices at 0%, the invoice must state the export contract number, the foreign party's name, the method of payment, and indicate the export customs declaration number when physical freight is involved. Non-compliance with transmission timing or template registration renders invoices invalid for input credit and shifts the entire VAT burden to the exporter.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT rate applies to services exported to foreign organizations or individuals and consumed entirely outside Vietnam, per Article 9(3)(c) of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, as reinforced by Circular 130/2016/TT-BTC and official guidance. For the patent and trademark prosecution agency, the following cumulative conditions must be satisfied: (i) the contractual counterparty is a foreign organization or a foreign individual with no permanent establishment or Vietnamese residence, and the contract is concluded through the LLC's Vietnamese establishment; (ii) the service deliverable is used and consumed abroad, which is met for PCT international patent applications, international design registrations, Madrid Protocol trademark filings, and representation before foreign national/regional patent offices; services consisting in representation before the National Office of Intellectual Property of Vietnam (NOIP) in connection with Vietnamese domestic patents or trademarks are deemed consumed in Vietnam and are taxable at 10%, even if the client is foreign; (iii) payment is made in a freely convertible foreign currency and is actually remitted to the LLC's Vietnamese bank account; (iv) the LLC retains complete contemporaneous documentation, including the contract, PCT/WIPO receipts, foreign office correspondence, and remittance evidence; (v) the exported services are not covered by the anti-abuse list for services deemed consumed in Vietnam (advertising, education, transportation of persons, restaurants, etc.), which does not apply to patent prosecution. The LLC must never claim VAT credit on input invoices that directly relate to domestic Vietnamese trademark representation; those are subject to standard 10% VAT and may be credited normally. Export turnover exceeding the 20% CIT rebasing thresholds will additionally require transfer-pricing documentation under Decree 132/2020.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Hải quan điện tử) — only when physical goods, samples, priority documents, or certified copies are exported; for electronic-only services this declaration is replaced by the service contract and service delivery proof
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (vận đơn đường biển/đường hàng không) — required solely to evidence physical movement of exported goods/documents

Inward Remittance Certificate (Giấy báo có) issued by a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank, or an original foreign bank SWIFT credit advice, evidencing receipt in the LLC's account of the export proceeds in convertible foreign currency from abroad

Service Export Contract concluded between the Vietnam LLC and the foreign client, in English or a foreign language, identifying the PCT/Madrid patent or trademark services and the foreign invoicing party
Official e-invoice issued by the LLC stating the 0% VAT rate and referencing the export contract

PCT Receipt, International Bureau filing receipt, WIPO Notice, or foreign national/regional patent office filing confirmation demonstrating that the service was rendered before a foreign authority and consumed outside Vietnam
Signed acceptance certificate, work-delivery record, or client email confirmation evidencing actual completion of the offshore service
Certificate of incorporation, commercial registration, or tax identification document of the foreign client proving its non-resident status
Foreign-currency bank account statement of the LLC demonstrating repatriation of the export proceeds within the statutory 180-day deadline
Written declaration/undertaking by the LLC that the service was not consumed within Vietnam, accompanied by a detailed calculation of attributable input VAT
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is a high-risk audit area: the tax authority may re-examine export dossiers for a period of up to 5 years from the violation date for tax evasion, and may enforce arrears within 10 years from the statutory payment deadline. Unsustained zero-rating is retroactively reclassified as domestic VAT at 10%, with the VAT deficiency assessed from the invoice date; late-payment interest runs at 0.03% per day on every unpaid day (Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14). Wrongfully obtained VAT refunds are clawed back in full with statutory interest from the date the refund was paid, plus an administrative penalty of 100% of the refunded amount, and the LLC's refund priority is suspended. For deliberate fraud or forgery of export documents, the evasion is punishable as tax evasion under Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13, Article 200: if the evaded tax is from VND 100,000,000 up to under VND 300,000,000, the responsible legal representative faces a fine up to 3x the evaded tax or imprisonment from 6 months to 7 years; a legal entity can be fined up to VND 4.5 billion and have its license suspended for up to 3 years. In addition, the Ministry of Science and Technology may suspend or revoke the agency's patent agent practice license for records falsification. There is no de minimis safe harbour for zero-rating; each transaction stands or falls on its own documentary integrity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV - Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam), being the sole central bank and foreign-exchange administration authority under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 as amended by Ordinance No. 08/2013/UBTVQH13; the SBV operates through its Foreign Exchange Department (formerly the Foreign Exchange Control Division) and licensed authorized credit institutions; the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) holds complementary competence for foreign direct investment registration and the Ministry of Finance (MOF) for fiscal, customs and tax-related cross-border reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese Dong (VND) is a limited-convertibility currency: the current account is substantially convertible for trade in services, meaning that payments by resident service providers such as an IP patent prosecution LLC to non-resident payees (foreign patent offices, WIPO, overseas associate attorneys) are permitted without prior SBV approval provided the underlying service contracts, invoices and documentary proof of service are presented to the authorized bank; the capital account, by contrast, remains tightly regulated and requires prior investment licensing, with all direct investment capital contributions, foreign loans, and profit/dividend remittances flowing through a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an authorized bank; profit remittance to the foreign investor is permitted only annually after finalization of corporate income tax, statutory audit, and settlement of all tax obligations; VND is not a fully convertible offshore currency and offshore NDFs are not legally available to Vietnamese resident corporates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance 2005 (as amended) and Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN dated 24 February 2015, a resident service exporter must repatriate the full amount of foreign-currency export earnings into a foreign-currency account opened at an authorized credit institution in Vietnam within 90 days from the date the export service is completed; where the contract provides for deferred payment, the proceeds must be credited to the authorized-bank foreign-currency account within 90 days from the contractual payment due date; no mandatory statutory conversion or surrender ratio is currently imposed on service export receipts, so the LLC may retain 100% of the foreign-currency proceeds in its foreign-currency account or voluntarily sell such proceeds to the authorized bank at the prevailing market exchange rate within the SBV-published daily central-rate band; documentary evidence comprising the export service contract, invoice, proof of service delivery (e.g., WIPO filing receipts, patent number confirmation) and bank transaction receipts must be retained for at least five years for SBV foreign-exchange inspection, corporate income tax finalization, and AML record-keeping purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury purposes; tolerated only as an ancillary rail. Vietnam does not maintain a statutory e-money institution (EMI) or digital-bank licensing regime equivalent to EU/UK EMIs, and offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Stripe, and similar platforms) are not authorized credit institutions, payment intermediaries, or DICA custodians under SBV regulations. Such EMIs may be used for low-value, high-frequency operational disbursements (for example, payment of official fees to WIPO, USPTO, or national intellectual property offices) and for collection of small client remittances from foreign applicants, provided funds are immediately mirrored through the licensed Vietnamese bank account for audit, tax-deduction, and FX-control evidence; EMIs cannot accept direct investment capital, cannot serve as the DICA, cannot be used for profit repatriation, and cannot replace the licensed-bank clearing leg; reliance on unregulated EMIs creates material tax-deductibility, transfer-pricing, and AML compliance risk and is therefore strictly supplemental.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person physical presence is mandatory for foreign-invested corporate onboarding in Vietnam. Under SBV Circular No. 23/2014/TT-NHNN (governing payment account opening) and prevailing banking practice, the registered legal representative of the LLC must personally appear at the authorized bank branch at least once for identity verification, wet-ink signature and seal specimen registration, and account activation; remote-only or video-KYC onboarding is not permitted for foreign-invested corporate accounts. If the legal representative is outside Vietnam, a Vietnamese-resident authorized signatory may attend and complete the opening under a notarized power of attorney, with the POA certified and consular-legalized or apostilled in accordance with Vietnamese law; however, at least one duly authorized representative must still appear physically for biometric checks, and the specimen signature of the legal representative, if absent, must be certified by a competent authority or authenticated by the bank itself within its internal risk appetite.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) opacity, including layered foreign holding structures, nominee shareholders, or inability to identify natural persons holding 25% or more of the LLC equity; banks treat this as a Level-1 AML red flag and may reject the account file.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate registry excerpt of the LLC; a complete shareholding/ownership chain diagram through every intermediate entity; passport copies of all ultimate and intermediate natural-person shareholders; a UBO declaration on the bank's template form confirming no nominee arrangement; and a professional legal opinion from licensed Vietnamese counsel confirming the ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of equity capital, such as an inbound capital wire lacking the statutory purpose code, an undocumented shareholder loan, or funding sourced from an unrelated third party.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); board resolution authorizing account opening and capital injection; the capital contribution schedule approved by the licensing authority; source-of-funds evidence comprising audited financial statements of the remitting shareholder and six-month bank statements of the transferor; and the original SWIFT MT103 message tagged with the SBV-compliant FDI capital injection purpose code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media screening hits on shareholders, authorized signatories, or contractual counterparties, especially where the ultimate parent or clients are situated in sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions and PEP screening report from a reputable due-diligence provider; a no-sanction-nexus legal opinion; government-issued identification for every matched individual; a written explanation of the screening hit, including dates, jurisdictions, and relationship context; and a risk-based engagement plan demonstrating enhanced monitoring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business-model mismatch where tax and patent-prosecution fee flows are mischaracterized as unlicensed money transmission or foreign-currency exchange activity, triggering rejection under Vietnamese AML law and SBV regulatory guidance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Industrial Property Agent registration certificate issued by the National Office of Intellectual Property (NOIP) under the Ministry of Science and Technology; copies of PCT and trademark prosecution service agreements; WIPO, USPTO, and national-patent-office filing confirmations; an accounting policy showing that official fees are collected and remitted as pass-through disbursements only; and a written Treasury policy confirming that no deposit-taking, payment intermediation, or money-transmission services are rendered.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk payment-chain complexity involving multiple intermediary correspondent banks, cash-equivalent instruments, or jurisdictions perceived as offshore financial centers in the disbursement chain for patent office and attorney fees.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A documented fee schedule from each patent office or foreign attorney; original invoices and signed engagement letters; evidence of the official-fee beneficiary (WIPO Geneva, USPTO Alexandria, EPO Munich, national IP offices); confirmation that each disbursement is a direct payment for an identified official fee or legal service; and a Treasury routing diagram showing the sanctioned-jurisdiction and correspondent-bank review performed before release of each payment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign investor remits equity capital via SWIFT MT103 to the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at the LLC's Vietnamese authorized bank, using the SBV-standardized transaction purpose code for foreign direct investment capital contribution; the remitting bank must credit the DICA within one business day and may convert the necessary VND portion at the onshore interbank USD/VND market rate within the SBV-published daily central-rate band; the bank verifies the remitted amount against the registered capital schedule stated in the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), and any excess remittance requires prior IRC amendment approval from the provincial licensing authority (Department of Planning and Investment or Industrial/Export-Processing Zone Authority); the DICA is the exclusive statutory conduit for the initial capital injection, subsequent capital increases, outbound profit remittance, dividend distribution, and foreign-loan drawings; routing equity capital through an offshore EMI, a third-party shareholder, or a non-DICA account constitutes a violation of Circular No. 06/2019/TT-NHNN and May expose the LLC to administrative sanctions and loss of corporate income tax incentives.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail is the onshore authorized-bank telegraphic transfer (SWIFT MT103) from the LLC's operational foreign-currency account or, following VND conversion, from the VND current account; this rail is used for payment of PCT international application fees to WIPO (Geneva), national-phase patent and trademark official fees to foreign IP offices, and overseas associate attorney invoices; the remitting bank requires the underlying service contract, official-fee invoice, and a declaration of sanctions/correspondent-bank review, and will not execute transfers to sanctioned beneficiaries; for high-value annuity or multi-jurisdiction filing portfolios, an irrevocable documentary commercial letter of credit (Commercial LC) may be opened in favor of foreign IP annuity-service providers, although the MT103 is the standard and preferred rail for service imports because it is faster, low-cost, and fully documentary for tax deduction; settlement is achieved on a same-day or T+1 basis through the bank's nostro accounts; offshore EMI rails (e.g., Wise) are permissible only for small-value official fees as an ancillary leg and must be supported by receipts that are polyglot-translated and retained for audit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable onshore USD/VND currency forwards (fixed and flexible maturity) transacted with authorized banks under SBV derivative regulations (Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN), used to hedge contractually committed official fees and overseas counsel costs denominated in USD or EUR
Cross-currency USD/VND swap agreements with licensed banks for the hedging of service-receipt and disbursement cash-flow mismatches arising from PCT filing cycles
Vanilla FX options (USD/VND call and put) offered by authorized banks on a proprietary basis solely for genuine commercial hedging, with no speculative or leveraged positioning

Natural hedging through retention of USD/EUR export service proceeds in the foreign-currency operating account and direct payment of official fees in the original invoice currency, thereby minimizing the need for FX conversion

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are NOT legally permissible for Vietnamese resident corporates because VND is not a freely convertible offshore currency; any onshore entity entering into an offshore NDF would face unenforceability and administrative penalties under Vietnamese foreign-exchange law

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the company's head-office province, filed via the National Business Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the annual anniversary of the Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing: administrative fine of VND 10,000,000 - 15,000,000 (approx. USD 390 - 590) under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP as amended by Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; continued non-compliance after written reminders (typically 6 months) can lead to revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate and administrative strike-off (forced dissolution) under Article 211 of the Law on Enterprises 2020.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard rate 20%. No general tax holiday for professional IP services. Incentives only if located in eligible industrial/economic zones or IT-focused enterprises: potential 10% preferential rate for 15 years plus 2-year CIT exemption and 50% reduction for up to 4 years (software production and eligible high-tech services), but a PCT patent prosecution agency (ISIC 7490) qualifies only if officially licensed as a high-tech enterprise/software enterprise and generating qualifying software-related income. Otherwise, standard 20% applies.
